question: In a certain code, "APPLE" is written as "BQQMF". How is "MANGO" written in that code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d83056f23da7ac569b1200ae88a0ebcdfdc52f64c81c253397407d67f97c25b.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Each letter is shifted **+1 forward** in the alphabet.

Here,

APPLE → BQQMF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84e0ed3b7f2da4a453fed1190ab477f5b176d314491784d39e8484e428ef276a.png] 

Now apply the same to **MANGO**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73bac1a3704d026c99c5feedf39e628f17882a06eb4f4c84c4c848bd34c72480.png] 

So, the code becomes **NBOHP.**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
